turns.query: Identify the air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025. What was the average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact same time (rounded to 1 decimal place)?
turns.actual_response:
At 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025, the highest PM10 concentration was recorded at Causeway Bay, with 35.7 µg/m³.

The average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 metres of that station at the same time was 53.3 km/h.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

analysis_time = "2025-10-05 14:00:00"
radius_m = 500.0

# Use already staged PM10 observations; do not re-fetch PM10.
pm10_df = pm10_observations_all_stations_20251005_1400_df.copy()

# Identify needed columns robustly from the staged dataframe.
pm10_col = "pm10"
station_id_col = "station_id" if "station_id" in pm10_df.columns else ("id" if "id" in pm10_df.columns else None)
station_name_col = next((c for c in ["name_en", "station_name", "station_name_en"] if c in pm10_df.columns), None)

if station_id_col is None or pm10_col not in pm10_df.columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Required PM10/station columns not found in staged PM10 dataframe. Columns available: {list(pm10_df.columns)}")

pm10_valid = pm10_df.dropna(subset=[pm10_col])
if pm10_valid.empty:
    spatial_highest_pm10_station_20251005_1400 = None
    spatial_nearby_traffic_500m_highest_pm10_20251005_1400 = None
    spatial_pm10_traffic_characterization_20251005_1400 = "No valid PM10 observations were available at the specified time, so the station-level traffic relationship could not be assessed."
    print(spatial_pm10_traffic_characterization_20251005_1400)
else:
    max_pm10 = float(pm10_valid[pm10_col].max())
    highest_rows = pm10_valid[pm10_valid[pm10_col] == max_pm10].copy()
    highest_rows = highest_rows.sort_values(by=[station_id_col]).reset_index(drop=True)
    highest_station_id = int(highest_rows.loc[0, station_id_col])
    highest_station_name = str(highest_rows.loc[0, station_name_col]) if station_name_col else station_names_from_knowledge_base.get(highest_station_id, f"Station {highest_station_id}")

    spatial_highest_pm10_station_20251005_1400 = {
        "station_id": highest_station_id,
        "station_name": highest_station_name,
        "pm10_ug_m3": max_pm10,
        "datetime": analysis_time,
        "tie_station_count": int(len(highest_rows))
    }

    # Count road segments within 500 m using metre-based spatial predicate.
    count_query = text("""
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS segment_count
        FROM road_segment rs
        JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic tr
          ON tr.road_segment_id = rs.id
        JOIN air_quality_station aqs
          ON aqs.id = :station_id
        WHERE tr.datetime = :analysis_time
          AND ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate, rs.geometry::geography, :radius_m)
          AND tr.speed IS NOT NULL
    """)
    nearby_count_df = pd.read_sql(count_query, engine, params={
        "station_id": highest_station_id,
        "analysis_time": analysis_time,
        "radius_m": radius_m
    })
    nearby_speed_record_count = int(nearby_count_df.loc[0, "segment_count"])

    if nearby_speed_record_count == 0:
        spatial_nearby_traffic_500m_highest_pm10_20251005_1400 = {
            "station_id": highest_station_id,
            "station_name": highest_station_name,
            "datetime": analysis_time,
            "radius_m": radius_m,
            "speed_record_count": 0,
            "average_speed_rounded_1dp": None
        }
        spatial_pm10_traffic_characterization_20251005_1400 = (
            f"{highest_station_name} had the highest PM10 concentration ({max_pm10:.1f} µg/m³) at {analysis_time}, "
            "but no road segments with recorded traffic speed were found within 500 m at that time, so a local traffic-speed relationship could not be quantified."
        )
    else:
        agg_query = text("""
            SELECT
                COUNT(*)::int AS speed_record_count,
                ROUND(AVG(tr.speed)::numeric, 1)::float AS average_speed_rounded_1dp,
                MIN(tr.speed)::float AS min_speed,
                MAX(tr.speed)::float AS max_speed,
                AVG(tr.congestion_index)::float AS average_congestion_index,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tr.congestion_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS smooth_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tr.congestion_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS slight_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tr.congestion_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS moderate_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tr.congestion_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS heavy_count
            FROM road_segment rs
            JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic tr
              ON tr.road_segment_id = rs.id
            JOIN air_quality_station aqs
              ON aqs.id = :station_id
            WHERE tr.datetime = :analysis_time
              AND ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate, rs.geometry::geography, :radius_m)
              AND tr.speed IS NOT NULL
        """)
        agg_df = pd.read_sql(agg_query, engine, params={
            "station_id": highest_station_id,
            "analysis_time": analysis_time,
            "radius_m": radius_m
        })
        r = agg_df.iloc[0].to_dict()
        nearby_avg_speed_rounded_1dp = float(r["average_speed_rounded_1dp"])

        congestion_counts = {
            "smooth": int(r["smooth_count"]),
            "slight": int(r["slight_count"]),
            "moderate": int(r["moderate_count"]),
            "heavy": int(r["heavy_count"])
        }
        dominant_congestion = max(congestion_counts, key=congestion_counts.get)

        spatial_nearby_traffic_500m_highest_pm10_20251005_1400 = {
            "station_id": highest_station_id,
            "station_name": highest_station_name,
            "datetime": analysis_time,
            "radius_m": radius_m,
            "speed_record_count": int(r["speed_record_count"]),
            "average_speed_rounded_1dp": nearby_avg_speed_rounded_1dp,
            "min_speed": float(r["min_speed"]),
            "max_speed": float(r["max_speed"]),
            "average_congestion_index": None if pd.isna(r["average_congestion_index"]) else float(r["average_congestion_index"]),
            "congestion_counts": congestion_counts,
            "dominant_congestion_status": dominant_congestion
        }

        if dominant_congestion in ["moderate", "heavy"]:
            relation_phrase = "co-occurred with locally congested traffic conditions"
        elif dominant_congestion == "slight":
            relation_phrase = "co-occurred with slight local traffic congestion"
        else:
            relation_phrase = "co-occurred with mostly smooth local traffic flow"

        spatial_pm10_traffic_characterization_20251005_1400 = (
            f"{highest_station_name} had the highest PM10 concentration ({max_pm10:.1f} µg/m³) at {analysis_time}. "
            f"Within 500 m, {int(r['speed_record_count'])} road segments had traffic-speed records, with an average speed of "
            f"{nearby_avg_speed_rounded_1dp:.1f}. This high PM10 reading {relation_phrase}; this is a single-station, single-hour "
            "co-location result and does not by itself establish causation."
        )

    print("Highest-PM10 station:", spatial_highest_pm10_station_20251005_1400)
    print("Nearby traffic summary:", spatial_nearby_traffic_500m_highest_pm10_20251005_1400)
    print("Characterization:", spatial_pm10_traffic_characterization_20251005_1400)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

analysis_time = "2025-10-05 14:00:00"
radius_m = 500.0

# Independent recomputation from raw records: highest PM10 station at the exact timestamp
pm10_query = text("""
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.id AS station_id,
        s.name_en AS station_name,
        h.pm10 AS pm10,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY h.pm10 DESC) AS pm10_rank
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
    JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = h.station_id
    WHERE h.datetime = :analysis_time
      AND h.pm10 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS tied_station_count,
    MIN(station_id) AS selected_station_id,
    STRING_AGG(station_name, ', ' ORDER BY station_id) AS highest_station_names,
    MAX(pm10) AS highest_pm10
FROM ranked
WHERE pm10_rank = 1
""")
pm10_top = pd.read_sql(pm10_query, engine, params={"analysis_time": analysis_time}).iloc[0]

highest_station_id = int(pm10_top["selected_station_id"])
highest_station_name = str(pm10_top["highest_station_names"])
max_pm10 = float(pm10_top["highest_pm10"])

# Independent recomputation from raw records: traffic speed over road segments within 500m of that station at the same timestamp
traffic_query = text("""
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS nearby_speed_record_count,
    AVG(t.speed)::double precision AS avg_speed,
    MIN(t.speed)::double precision AS min_speed,
    MAX(t.speed)::double precision AS max_speed
FROM air_quality_station s
JOIN road_segment r
  ON ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, s.coordinate, :radius_m)
JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic t
  ON t.road_segment_id = r.id
 AND t.datetime = :analysis_time
WHERE s.id = :station_id
  AND t.speed IS NOT NULL
""")
traffic_stats = pd.read_sql(
    traffic_query, engine,
    params={"analysis_time": analysis_time, "station_id": highest_station_id, "radius_m": radius_m}
).iloc[0]

nearby_speed_record_count = int(traffic_stats["nearby_speed_record_count"])
avg_speed_near_pm10_independent = None if pd.isna(traffic_stats["avg_speed"]) else float(traffic_stats["avg_speed"])
nearby_avg_speed_rounded_1dp = None if avg_speed_near_pm10_independent is None else round(avg_speed_near_pm10_independent, 1)

# Assign required/final variables
old_avg_speed_near_pm10 = globals().get("avg_speed_near_pm10", None)
avg_speed_near_pm10 = nearby_avg_speed_rounded_1dp
